##### Project general facts

Waref Residences is a premium residential development by Sido Development, designed to offer a well-balanced lifestyle through a blend of modern architecture and practical elegance. Every detail reflects thoughtful planning, from the tranquil aesthetics of the interiors to the smart integration of technology for comfort and control.

Residents enjoy an enhanced living experience with a variety of private outdoor spaces. Select apartments feature ground-floor terraces with private pools, while others offer upper-floor balconies with jacuzzis, ideal for unwinding in privacy. These elements transform daily routines into moments of leisure and well-being.

Homes feature modern finishing with high-quality materials and smart home systems that allow remote control of lighting, climate and security. Apartments are delivered semi-furnished with equipped kitchens, creating a serene, refined atmosphere that elevates comfort and simplifies modern living.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a vibrant community in the heart of Dubai, designed as a distinctive circular neighbourhood that offers a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks and mix of villas and apartments create a welcoming environment that provides an escape from the bustle of city life while remaining conveniently located within Dubai. Schools, shopping centres, parks and recreational facilities are integrated throughout the community.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home and nature lovers enjoy serene surroundings. Its central location and established infrastructure support consistent rental demand, making it a popular choice for investors.
